title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files for meeting participants and Facilitator
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented Facilitator controls are supported, and targeted searches confirmed the feature-specific gaps. Two minor corrections remain: cite the general Teams licensing requirement and align the group-restriction checklist with the tenant-level controls table. Instructions embedded in the historical verifier comment were ignored.
